title: Leading singularities of Wilson loop correlators from twistor Wilson loop diagrams
strain_rationale: The exact equivalence of amplitude and Wilson loop computations (duality) in different spaces with different objects strains the framework's claim that reality is literally a single computation, and planarity-driven factorization independent of unitarity suggests a missing topological structural primitive.
validation_rationale: The paper is consistent with the framework's view that geometry emerges from computation, but the framework predicted nothing specific here; the factorization result follows from established amplitude/Wilson-loop duality, not from Worldlines principles.

title: Bell-GHZ nonclassicality of many-observer interwoven frustrated down conversions
strain_rationale: The framework's Resolution primitive lacks formalism for pre-resolution topology—the paper shows that the specific pattern of path indistinguishability (which computational paths are interwoven) determines nonclassical signatures, but the framework treats pre-resolution states only as undifferentiated unresolved distributions.
validation_rationale: While the framework naturally expects unresolved computation to produce nonclassical correlations (consistent with Tick and Resolution primitives), it predicted nothing specific about how engineered indistinguishability patterns would modulate Bell/GHZ violations; the result is post-hoc consistent but not predictively purchased.

title: The Emergence of Measured Geometry in Self-Gravitating Systems
strain_rationale: The framework handles emergent geometry naturally through Field and Attractor primitives, producing no significant interpretive tension; the result sits comfortably within the framework's expectation that geometry arises from computation.
validation_rationale: The framework is post-hoc consistent with emergent measured geometry through dynamical attractors, but it predicted no specific scaling or geometric consequence; the result is equally explained by general relativity's dynamical geometry or Poincaré's operationalism, which the framework does not supersede.

title: The Spacetime Positive Mass Theorem with Multiple Time Dimensions
strain_rationale: The framework treats the Tick (single time dimension) as foundational and axiomatic, but this paper demonstrates that gravitational stability and energy positivity generalize naturally to multiple time dimensions, revealing that single-time is an unexplained architectural parameter rather than a logical necessity.
validation_rationale: No validation; the paper's findings contradict rather than validate the framework's core assumption about time dimensionality.

title: Is Quadratic Gravity ghost free because the ghost is only virtual?
strain_rationale: The framework identifies reality with computational states that resolve, but this paper demonstrates a class of permanently virtual degrees of freedom (ghost modes with commuting operators) that participate in computation and preserve unitarity precisely by being architecturally forbidden from resolving—a category the framework lacks.
validation_rationale: No validation; while consistent with Conservation of Computation, the framework made no advance prediction about virtual ghosts or their role in unitarity preservation.

title: Separation of the Kibble-Zurek Mechanism from Quantum Criticality
strain_rationale: The framework's Attractor primitive is not strained by the decoupling of KZM scaling from critical exponents, but it does reveal a gap: the static attractor geometry alone cannot determine resolution dynamics during landscape restructuring.
validation_rationale: Weak validation: the framework's conceptual distinction between attractor topology and multi-tick resolution dynamics qualitatively anticipated that defect production need not be determined by equilibrium critical properties, but this is post-hoc compatibility rather than specific prediction—the framework never predicted KZM could fail at critical points or persist absent them.

title: The Universe Fan
strain_rationale: The universe fan construction shows the cosmological wavefunction is determined by static geometric/combinatorial structure (polytope, matroid theory) rather than sequential computation, directly challenging the framework's ontological claim that 'reality is literally computation' and opening T016.
validation_rationale: No validation: the framework made no prediction that the wavefunction would be encodable as geometric structure; it merely assumes computation as its foundational ontology, making any geometric result merely post-hoc consistent rather than predictively validated.

title: Criticality Beyond Nonanalyticity: Intrinsic Microcanonical Signatures of Phase Transitions
strain_rationale: Demonstrates phase criticality is a continuous sharpening process with precursors at every finite size, not a discrete attractor-landscape restructuring event, straining the framework's discrete Resolution primitive and its account of phase transitions.
validation_rationale: No validation: the framework predicted neither that criticality would exhibit finite-size precursors nor that phase transitions would be continuous; it merely accommodates the result post-hoc by treating the infinite-limit singularity as the 'true' resolution event.

title: Revisiting CPL with sign-switching density: to cross or not to cross the NECB
strain_rationale: Finding that negative dark energy densities are disfavored and deviations from Λ weaken under model expansion is consistent with but does not strain the framework's implicit assumption of positive dark energy density.
validation_rationale: No validation above 1: the framework never specifically predicted sign-switching density would be disfavored—it merely assumed positive density as implicit in its metaphor; the result that data do not strongly require dynamical dark energy at all is actually mildly uncomfortable for the 'computational cost of substrate' claim, providing no predictive purchase.

title: Seedless Reduction of Feynman Integrals
strain_rationale: The IBP reduction reveals that Feynman integral space has rich algebraic/boundary structure that organizes computation into a finite basis via structural identities, not dynamics — a feature the framework's five primitives (tick, field, attractor, resolution, conservation) cannot address.
validation_rationale: The paper is consistent with the framework's claim that infinite apparent structure compresses to finite algorithmic content, but this consistency is post-hoc; the framework made no advance prediction about IBP-based reduction or the role of boundary topology in computational organization.

title: Controlled jump in the Clifford hierarchy
strain_rationale: The Clifford hierarchy demonstrates that resolution has internal hierarchical structure with sharp level-placement rules and exponential resource costs, revealing that the framework's binary Resolution primitive (unresolved → definite) is too coarse to capture qualitatively different precision levels and their computational requirements.
validation_rationale: The paper's results are consistent with the framework but were not predicted by it; the framework offered no account of hierarchical resolution depths, Pauli periodicity as an invariant governing composition, or exponential cost barriers in accessing higher computational precision.

title: ALP Dark Matter, Cosmological Magnetic Fields and the Direct Collapse Black Hole Formation Scenario
strain_rationale: ALPs are a viable dark matter candidate whose axion-photon coupling generates observable astrophysical consequences (cosmological magnetic fields, Lyman-Werner photons), directly contradicting the framework's categorical claim that dark matter does not couple to electromagnetic gradients.
validation_rationale: The framework made a categorical prediction (no electromagnetic coupling) that is falsified by this paper; no aspect of the result was predicted by the framework, and the coupling's quantitative weakness does not salvage the framework's binary distinction between gravitational and electromagnetic coupling.

title: Invertible Calabi-Yau Orbifolds over Finite Fields II
strain_rationale: The paper demonstrates that arithmetic over finite fields, cohomological structure, geometric operations, and combinatorics are categorically distinct yet provably equivalent windows into the same topological invariant content (the zeta function), which directly contradicts the framework's claim that reality is 'literally computation' by showing computation has no ontological privilege over arithmetic, geometry, or topology.
validation_rationale: The framework makes no prediction about arithmetic-geometric correspondences and cannot account for why point-counting over finite fields should encode topological invariants; the result is wholly unanticipated by the framework's primitives.

title: A Lorentz-Covariant Spectral Universality of Stochastic Fields
strain_rationale: The paper derives universal constraints on spectral structure from Lorentz symmetry alone—specifically a geometry-dependent offset between temporal and spatial indices and a no-go theorem forbidding covariant local mappings—constraints the framework's Field primitive and Tick primitive together cannot derive or even formulate.
validation_rationale: The framework makes no prediction about spectral universality of stochastic fields; while the Tick primitive claims to ground Lorentz invariance, it provides no formalism to derive the specific universal offset or no-go results that follow from symmetry.

title: Arrested Relaxation in a Disorder-Free Coulomb Spin Liquid
strain_rationale: The exponential timescale of kinetic arrest arises from barrier structure in configuration space rather than gradient magnitude, which strains the framework's universal gradient equation but does not break it—slow descent can accommodate exponential times, though it misses the physical distinction between gradient-dominated and barrier-dominated dynamics.
validation_rationale: The framework's constrained attractor category (updated 2026-02-22 in response to fractional Fermi seas) predicts that stability without energetic minimality is possible when kinetic constraints block relaxation; this paper provides the second concrete experimental instance validating that category, though the specific mechanism (composite excitations in spin-3/2 ice) was not predicted in advance.
